title: Patient Encounter Skills (1B)
sourceNote: History coverage graded from the transcript. The case adds its SP physical exam checklist (peChecklist) and the post-encounter note key (penKey) at grading time. The pass threshold is a placeholder.

items.label: PMH: conditions
items.guidance: Asks about past medical conditions.

items.label: PMH: when diagnosed
items.guidance: Asks when conditions were diagnosed.

items.label: PSH: surgeries / procedures
items.guidance: Asks about past surgeries or procedures.

items.label: PSH: dates
items.guidance: Asks when surgeries/procedures happened.

items.label: Medications: names
items.guidance: Asks what medications the patient takes.

items.label: Medications: doses
items.guidance: Asks about doses / how often taken.

items.label: Medications: over-the-counter and supplements
items.guidance: Asks specifically about OTC medicines, herbal products or supplements.

items.label: Allergies: drug
items.guidance: Asks about medication allergies.

items.label: Allergies: food
items.guidance: Asks about food allergies.

items.label: Allergies: type of reaction
items.guidance: Asks what reaction occurred.

items.label: FH: parents and siblings living / age and cause of death
items.guidance: Asks about the health of parents and siblings, and age/cause of death where applicable.

items.label: SH: alcohol
